name: ClickTime
description_en:
ClickTime structures employee time for project billing, labor-cost allocation and capacity decisions. Its current AI offering reads connected work tools and proposes project/cost coding for the team to confirm. The homepage explicitly distinguishes this from screenshot or keystroke monitoring.

Recorded hours, approved costs and financial classification are separate stages. A finance-oriented implementation needs the correct rates, work types and approval path before it can rely on reports.
description_zh:
ClickTime 将员工工时组织为项目计费、人工成本分配和容量决策资料。当前 AI 产品读取连接的工作工具，并建议项目/成本编码，由团队确认。首页明确区分这一方式与截图或键盘监控。

已记录工时、已批准成本及财务分类属于不同阶段。面向财务的实施需先配置正确费率、工作类型与审批路径，再依赖报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Map work time to projects and financial categories for review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将工作时间映射至项目及财务分类以供审查。

core_features.explanation_en: Team adds approvals/cost rates; Premier adds project budgets and resource management.
core_features.explanation_zh: Team 加审批/成本费率，Premier 加项目预算及资源管理。

en: Connect the intended work/calendar source, define project and cost codes, then review suggested entries. A meeting with a client name is not automatically evidence that every minute is billable or capitalizable. Compare the proposed classification with the work actually performed before approval. Test a mixed-purpose meeting and a corrected entry, not just a straightforward client call. No source connection or accounting classification was executed here.
zh: 连接计划使用的工作/日历来源、定义项目及成本编码，再审查建议记录。含客户名称的会议，不能自动证明每分钟都可计费或资本化。审批前应对照实际工作及建议分类，并测试混合目的会议和更正记录，而非只测简单客户电话。本文未实际连接来源或执行财务分类。

sections.title_zh: 示例：审查被映射到项目的会议
sections.en: Connect the intended work/calendar source, define project and cost codes, then review suggested entries. A meeting with a client name is not automatically evidence that every minute is billable or capitalizable. Compare the proposed classification with the work actually performed before approval. Test a mixed-purpose meeting and a corrected entry, not just a straightforward client call. No source connection or accounting classification was executed here.
sections.zh: 连接计划使用的工作/日历来源、定义项目及成本编码，再审查建议记录。含客户名称的会议，不能自动证明每分钟都可计费或资本化。审批前应对照实际工作及建议分类，并测试混合目的会议和更正记录，而非只测简单客户电话。本文未实际连接来源或执行财务分类。

sections.title_en: Plan layers and costs need a quote
sections.title_zh: 层级及成本需结合报价
sections.en:
The pricing page says Starter begins at $12 per user per month without reliably binding that headline to the selected cadence in the read text. Team adds AI mapping, approvals and cost rates; Premier adds budgeting/resource management, while Enterprise adds custom integration/security/onboarding. Expense tracking is separately listed at $4 per user monthly as an add-on.

Confirm seat minimums, currency/tax, monthly/annual commitment and each module in the quote. A request-demo button does not establish a free subscription. Compliance-related labels do not decide a company’s accounting or tax treatment.
sections.zh:
定价页表示 Starter 每用户每月 $12 起，但读取文本未可靠绑定所选周期。Team 加 AI 映射、审批和成本费率，Premier 加预算/资源管理，Enterprise 加定制集成、安全及入门协助。费用记录另列为每用户每月 $4 附加项。

报价中需确认最低席位、货币/税费、月付/年付承诺及模块。演示按钮不能证明免费订阅，合规相关标签也不能决定企业会计或税务处理。

sections.title_en: Start with a reconciled labor-data sample
sections.title_zh: 从已核对的人工数据样本开始
sections.en:
Prepare people, project IDs, historical rates, access roles and an export destination. For a missing entry, inspect source permissions and approval state before importing again; a repeated import can distort cost totals. Financial users should reconcile a sample report to the source time records.

Services/finance teams can evaluate this model; personal focus tracking and attendance geofencing are different requirements. No API, AI accuracy, payroll delivery, software licence, data export completeness or recovery was tested. The read offering is a managed platform.
sections.zh:
准备人员、项目标识、历史费率、访问角色及导出目标。记录缺失时，重新导入前检查来源权限与审批状态，重复导入可能扭曲成本。财务人员应将样本报告与来源工时核对。

服务/财务团队可评估这一模型，个人专注及定位考勤是不同需求。未测试 API、AI 准确性、薪资交付、软件许可、导出完整性或恢复。已读方案为托管平台。
